intro.uz: Nodira dugonasi Zarinaga elektron xat yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: qoʻshnilaringizni taniysizmi? Ular qanday odamlar?

paragraphs.en: Hi Zarina, How are you? I have news. We have a new neighbour! Her name is Saida. She lives in the flat next to ours. She is from Fergana.
paragraphs.uz: Salom, Zarina! Qalaysan? Yangilik bor. Bizning yangi qoʻshnimiz bor! Uning ismi Saida. U bizning yonimizdagi kvartirada yashaydi. U Fargʻonadan.

paragraphs.en: Saida is a doctor at the children's hospital. She is kind and friendly. She has a little son. His name is Amir, and he is four. He loves cats.
paragraphs.uz: Saida bolalar kasalxonasida shifokor. U mehribon va xushmuomala. Uning kichkina oʻgʻli bor. Uning ismi Amir, u toʻrt yoshda. U mushuklarni yaxshi koʻradi.

paragraphs.en: Every evening, Amir plays with my cat Laylo in the yard. Saida often comes to our home for tea. My mother likes her very much.
paragraphs.uz: Har kuni kechqurun Amir mening mushugim Laylo bilan hovlida oʻynaydi. Saida tez-tez bizga choyga keladi. Onam uni juda yaxshi koʻradi.

paragraphs.en: Come to my house on Saturday. You can meet them! Love, Nodira
paragraphs.uz: Shanba kuni uyimga kel. Ular bilan tanishishing mumkin! Mehr bilan, Nodira
